name: Indian Ocean stellar-altitude navigation
description: Indian Ocean navigators used a portable astronomical instrument as part of celestial navigation.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source.

events.statement: Seydi Ali Reis described a star-altitude navigation instrument used by Indian Ocean navigators in his 1554 nautical work.
events.caveats: The dated treatise is a textual witness; the author does not identify when this capability first emerged or establish a particular voyage.
